Headline: Blue Line Service Delayed Clinton
ShortDescription: Blue Line trains are standing near Clinton due to police activity. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Blue Line trains are standing near Clinton due to police activity.

At this time, also consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #78 Montrose Temporary Eastbound Reroute near Wilson/Broadway
ShortDescription: Eastbound #78 Montrose buses are temporarily rerouted due to street blockage near Wilson/Broadway.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Eastbound #78 Montrose buses are temporarily rerouted via Wilson, Broadway, Lawrence, Sheridan, and Wilson, due to street blockage near Wilson/Broadway.

Westbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
